summary: The ℚ(i) discriminant results and their private proof scaffold duplicate Mathlib's cyclotomic discriminant API. The new quadratic basis helper is also not reused in the adjacent square-root discriminant proof, leaving duplicated basis-construction plumbing in TauCeti.
